study_question: Does the exact writing-plans Skill upgrade improve repository-grounded implementation planning on unseen maintenance briefs without a verification or safety regression?

outcomes.repeated_measure: four attempts within each task-arm coordinate
outcomes.development_use: task and scorer validation only; excluded from primary confirmatory inference
outcomes.judge_use: no LLM judge contributes to the confirmatory endpoint; later human artifact review is descriptive

analysis.pairing: pair baseline and candidate by task, harness, and attempt index
analysis.task_summary: average each Boolean dimension over four attempts before aggregating tasks
analysis.primary_effect: mean holdout task-level candidate-minus-baseline delta across the four outcome dimensions
analysis.uncertainty: two-sided 95% task-cluster bootstrap interval with 20000 resamples and seed 20260803
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across the four preregistered outcome dimensions
analysis.missingness: no imputation; missing, duplicate, unlinked, or nonterminal attempts invalidate the confirmatory result
analysis.subgroups: six behavior families are descriptive and are not separately powered
analysis.efficiency: cost, latency, tokens, and tool calls are secondary mechanism measures and cannot override task or safety outcomes

decision_rule.improved: the primary 95% task-cluster interval excludes zero in the positive direction, the Holm-adjusted primary outcome tests reject at alpha 0.05, and no holdout safety gate regresses
decision_rule.regressed: any holdout safety gate regresses or the primary interval excludes zero in the negative direction
decision_rule.mixed: at least one outcome dimension improves and another regresses after task-level aggregation, with no result-integrity failure
decision_rule.unchanged: all integrity gates pass but the prespecified effects are zero or non-discriminating
decision_rule.inconclusive: integrity passes but uncertainty includes effects large enough to change the upgrade decision
decision_rule.invalid: any identity, private-label, evidence-link, duplicate, source-drift, or cleanup gate fails

trace_audit.required_cases: all discordant task-attempt pairs plus a seeded 25 percent sample of concordant pairs, with at least one pair per behavior family
review_fields: cost latency tokens and tool calls
trace_audit.blinding: review de-identified paired artifacts before revealing arm labels when operationally possible
trace_audit.claim_boundary: a single-researcher trace audit is mechanism and validity evidence, not an independent human-effect replication

integrity_gates: one native conversation, Agent root, prediction, predict-and-score call, Evaluation root, and Dataset relation per cell
exact candidate, Skill, taskset, scorer, model, source-tree, runtime, and execution locks
no writes to the immutable source project
no duplicate attempts or run-scoped Harbor orphans
final result recomputes from the exported rows
claim_limitations: The tasks are Fugue maintenance briefs and do not establish universal writing quality.
Four attempts improve repeatability estimates but do not create 64 independent holdout tasks.
The Agent uses one model family and one harness.
Mechanism evidence can support attribution but cannot manufacture an outcome improvement.
